metadata.description: Database of drug-food interactions for DrugGuard

grapefruit.name: Grapefruit & Citrus
grapefruit.description: Inhibits CYP3A4 enzyme, affecting drug metabolism

tyramine.name: Tyramine-Rich Foods
tyramine.description: Can cause hypertensive crisis with MAOIs

dairy.name: Dairy Products
dairy.description: Calcium binds to certain drugs reducing absorption

alcohol.name: Alcohol
alcohol.description: Enhances CNS depression, affects drug metabolism

potassium.name: High Potassium Foods
potassium.description: Risk of hyperkalemia with certain drugs

interactions.effect: Vitamin K-rich foods can reduce anticoagulant effect, increasing clot risk
interactions.recommendation: Maintain consistent vitamin K intake. Don't suddenly increase or decrease green vegetable consumption.

interactions.effect: Alcohol can increase bleeding risk and affect INR levels
interactions.recommendation: Limit alcohol consumption. Avoid binge drinking. Monitor INR closely.

interactions.effect: Grapefruit may increase warfarin levels
interactions.recommendation: Avoid or limit grapefruit consumption

interactions.effect: Grapefruit inhibits CYP3A4, dramatically increasing statin levels and risk of muscle damage (rhabdomyolysis)
interactions.recommendation: Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice completely

interactions.effect: Grapefruit can increase simvastatin blood levels up to 15-fold
interactions.recommendation: Completely avoid grapefruit products

interactions.effect: Grapefruit significantly increases lovastatin exposure
interactions.recommendation: Avoid grapefruit products entirely

interactions.effect: Alcohol increases risk of lactic acidosis, especially in fasting state
interactions.recommendation: Limit alcohol intake significantly. Never drink on empty stomach.

interactions.effect: High fiber may slightly reduce metformin absorption
interactions.recommendation: Take metformin with meals. No need to avoid fiber.

interactions.effect: Calcium in dairy products chelates ciprofloxacin, reducing absorption by up to 40%
interactions.recommendation: Take ciprofloxacin 2 hours before or 6 hours after dairy products

interactions.effect: Calcium significantly reduces tetracycline absorption
interactions.recommendation: Avoid dairy products 2 hours before and after taking doxycycline

interactions.effect: Dairy products can reduce tetracycline absorption by more than 50%
interactions.recommendation: Take 1 hour before or 2 hours after dairy consumption

interactions.effect: Calcium reduces levothyroxine absorption
interactions.recommendation: Take levothyroxine on empty stomach, 4 hours apart from calcium

interactions.effect: High fiber foods can reduce levothyroxine absorption
interactions.recommendation: Take levothyroxine on empty stomach, separate from high-fiber meals

interactions.effect: Coffee may reduce levothyroxine absorption
interactions.recommendation: Wait at least 30 minutes after taking levothyroxine before drinking coffee

interactions.effect: Tyramine can cause life-threatening hypertensive crisis with MAOIs
interactions.recommendation: Strictly avoid all tyramine-rich foods. This is critical.

interactions.effect: Tyramine accumulation can cause severe hypertension, stroke
interactions.recommendation: Complete avoidance of aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods required

interactions.effect: Risk of hypertensive crisis, especially at higher doses
interactions.recommendation: Avoid tyramine-rich foods. Risk is dose-dependent.

interactions.effect: ACE inhibitors raise potassium levels; high potassium foods compound this risk
interactions.recommendation: Moderate potassium intake. Avoid potassium-based salt substitutes.

interactions.effect: Risk of hyperkalemia with ACE inhibitors
interactions.recommendation: Monitor potassium levels. Limit high-potassium foods.

interactions.effect: Spironolactone causes potassium retention; high potassium foods can cause dangerous hyperkalemia
interactions.recommendation: Significantly limit high-potassium foods. Regular potassium monitoring.

interactions.effect: Grapefruit can increase amlodipine levels, causing low blood pressure
interactions.recommendation: Limit grapefruit consumption

interactions.effect: Grapefruit can triple felodipine blood levels
interactions.recommendation: Avoid grapefruit completely

interactions.effect: Combined CNS depression can cause severe sedation, respiratory depression
interactions.recommendation: Avoid alcohol completely while taking benzodiazepines

interactions.effect: Potentiates sedative effects, risk of overdose
interactions.recommendation: Do not consume alcohol

interactions.effect: Life-threatening respiratory depression
interactions.recommendation: Never consume alcohol with opioids

interactions.effect: Severe respiratory depression, may be fatal
interactions.recommendation: Absolutely no alcohol consumption

interactions.effect: Chronic alcohol use increases risk of hepatotoxicity
interactions.recommendation: Limit dose to 2g/day if consuming alcohol regularly. Avoid if possible.

interactions.effect: Caffeine and theophylline are both xanthines; combined effect increases side effects
interactions.recommendation: Limit caffeine intake while on theophylline

interactions.effect: Caffeine can reduce lithium levels; sudden changes affect drug level
interactions.recommendation: Maintain consistent caffeine intake. Don't suddenly stop or increase.

interactions.effect: Food, especially calcium, dramatically reduces absorption
interactions.recommendation: Take on empty stomach with plain water only. Wait 30-60 minutes before eating.

interactions.effect: Alcohol increases methotrexate hepatotoxicity
interactions.recommendation: Avoid alcohol or limit significantly

interactions.effect: Grapefruit increases cyclosporine levels, risking toxicity
interactions.recommendation: Avoid grapefruit completely

interactions.effect: Grapefruit can increase sildenafil levels
interactions.recommendation: Avoid grapefruit juice

interactions.effect: Alcohol can cause severe hypoglycemia, especially without food
interactions.recommendation: Limit alcohol. Never drink on an empty stomach. Monitor blood glucose closely.

interactions.effect: Risk of hypoglycemia and disulfiram-like reaction
interactions.recommendation: Limit alcohol significantly
